details.about_story:
TeeBravo is an online store for printed clothing and accessories, with designs inspired by hobbies, everyday interests and holidays. Find a T-shirt that feels like you, a hoodie for your days off or a gift that brings someone you know to mind.

Each item is printed after you place your order. A design may be available on several products, so you can choose from the styles, colors and sizes shown on its product page. Check the materials and size guide for your selection before ordering.

We are based in Hanoi, Vietnam, and sell to customers in the United States. We work with production and shipping partners to fulfill orders. For product questions or help with a delivery, contact TeeBravo directly. If your item arrives damaged, has a printing defect or is different from what you ordered, our Returns & Refunds policy explains how to request a replacement or refund.
details.restrictions: We currently ship only to the United States, with no additional destination restrictions within the United States. International shipping is not available.
details.returns_eligibility:
If your item arrives damaged, has a manufacturing or printing defect, or is different from what you ordered, you can choose a free replacement or a refund once we verify the problem. This covers the wrong design, product, color or size, as well as garment measurements outside the tolerance in the product's size guide.

We print every item to order, so we do not accept returns or exchanges for a change of mind, a size or color chosen incorrectly, or a fit preference when the item matches your order and its size guide. Please check the measurements before buying.

Normal wear, misuse and damage from washing against the care instructions are not covered. Nothing in this policy limits your rights under applicable consumer law.
details.returns_window:
Contact us within 30 calendar days of delivery about a damaged, defective or incorrect item. You only need to report the problem within that time; you do not need to send anything back.

If your order has not arrived by the latest estimated delivery date, contact us as soon as possible, preferably within 30 calendar days of that date, so we can investigate. These reporting periods do not limit your statutory rights or remedies.
details.returns_method:
Email us at the support address below with your order reference, the email address used at checkout and a description of the problem. For damage, a misprint or the wrong item, attach clear photos of the item and the issue. For a sizing problem, include the size label and a photo showing the garment's measurements. If you cannot provide photos, let us know so we can discuss another way to review the issue.

We will check your order and the information you send, then email you with our decision or any questions. If we approve your claim, you can choose a free replacement or a refund. If a replacement is unavailable, we will refund you.

Approved claims do not require a physical return. Keep the item while we review your claim, and do not mail it to our business address. Replacements follow the production and transit estimates in our Shipping Policy.
details.returns_fees:
There is no claim fee, restocking fee or return shipping charge for an approved claim for a damaged, defective or incorrect item. We cover the replacement and its shipping, and you do not have to return the original item.

If you choose a refund, we refund the affected item's purchase price, applicable tax and the shipping paid for that item. If the whole order is affected or we cancel it, we refund the full amount paid, including shipping and applicable tax.
details.refund_timing:
We send approved refunds to your original payment method within 2 business days of approval and email you once the refund has been submitted. Your bank or card issuer may need another 5 to 10 business days to show the credit. We do not replace refunds with store credit.

If the credit has not appeared after that time, email us at the support address below and we will help trace it. Any shorter deadline required by law takes priority.
details.privacy_details:
Technical information
When you visit, our hosting services process technical information such as IP addresses, browser details, requested pages and error logs to deliver the website, troubleshoot problems and protect it from misuse. We use order, payment and support records to fulfill purchases, handle claims, prevent fraud and meet accounting or legal obligations.

Service providers
We share the information needed to provide these services with Stripe, production and fulfillment partners, shipping carriers, hosting providers and email or support services. For example, a fulfillment partner needs the ordered items and delivery details to ship your parcel. Stripe handles payment information under its own privacy policy at https://stripe.com/privacy. We do not store full payment card numbers or card security codes in our store database. We may disclose records when required by law or to resolve fraud, payment disputes or legal claims.

Cookies and choices
A cart cookie connects your browser to your shopping cart. We also save your chosen display theme. Where a cookie preference prompt is shown, we also remember that choice. You can clear local storage and cookies or block them in your browser, although blocking essential cookies may prevent the cart or checkout from working. The current storefront does not use advertising pixels or third-party analytics trackers. We will update this policy and provide any required choices before introducing them. We do not sell personal information or share it for cross-context behavioral advertising.

Retention and international processing
We keep personal information for as long as needed to fulfill orders, provide support and meet applicable recordkeeping duties. Records needed for tax, fraud prevention or a dispute may be retained after an order is completed or a deletion request is made. We delete or de-identify information when it is no longer needed. TeeBravo is based in Vietnam; information may be processed there and in countries where our service providers operate, including the United States. We use safeguards required by applicable law for international transfers.

Your requests
Email us at the support address below to request access, correction or deletion of your personal information, or to ask about other rights available under the law that applies to you. We may need to verify your identity using information associated with your order. Do not send a password or full payment card details. We respond within applicable legal deadlines and explain any lawful reason we cannot complete a request. We do not discriminate against customers for exercising privacy rights. If applicable law gives you a right to appeal a decision, reply to our response to request a review.

Children and security
The store is intended for adults making purchases, including adults buying children's clothing. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. Contact us if you believe a child has provided personal information. We use reasonable safeguards to protect information, but no online service can promise absolute security.

Policy changes
We may update this policy when our practices change. We will provide additional notice when the law requires it.
details.terms_conditions:
Placing an order
You must be legally able to enter a purchase agreement or have authorization from a parent or guardian. Provide accurate contact and delivery details and use a payment method you are authorized to use. Your payment confirmation records the transaction. Before production, we may need to contact you about an unavailable item, an obvious listing error or a suspected unauthorized payment. If we cannot complete your order, we will notify you and refund the amount paid for the cancelled items, including their shipping and applicable tax. We will not charge a higher corrected price without your agreement.

Changes and cancellations
Email us at the support address below as soon as possible to request a cancellation or a change to the size, color or delivery address. We can make changes or cancel with a full refund if production has not started. Once production begins, we cannot accept change-of-mind cancellations or guarantee changes. This does not affect remedies for faulty goods, our shipping-delay obligations or other rights under applicable law.

Product descriptions
Read the garment details and size guide for the product you choose. Fit and materials can differ between garments. Images illustrate the design and placement; screen settings and the printing process may cause minor color differences. This does not excuse a materially different item, an incorrect print or a manufacturing defect.

Delivery and problems
Processing and transit estimates are set out in our Shipping Policy. Express shipping does not bypass production. If we cannot ship within the stated processing period, we will contact you with a revised estimate and the option to cancel for a full refund, and obtain consent to a delay where required. We remain your point of contact for delivery problems and approved replacement or refund claims. Our Returns & Refunds policy applies to damaged, defective and incorrect items and explains the limits on non-defective returns.

Using the website
Do not misuse the website, attempt unauthorized access, submit fraudulent orders or interfere with other customers. Buying a product does not give you permission to reproduce or commercially use its artwork, photographs or other protected content. Intellectual property remains with its respective rights holders. Send an infringement concern to our support email below with enough detail for us to identify the material and review your claim.

Consumer rights and disputes
These terms do not exclude rights or remedies that cannot lawfully be excluded, including rights relating to faulty or misdescribed goods. We do not require you to waive those rights or agree to mandatory arbitration. Contact us at the support address below first if there is a problem so we can work toward a resolution. Applicable law determines any additional rights and the courts with jurisdiction.

Updates
The purchase terms in effect when you place your order apply to that order. Later changes apply to future purchases and do not reduce rights attached to an existing order.

pages.content:
Where we ship
{{restrictions}}

Production and processing
We print your item after you order. Processing takes {{processing_time}} before shipment, starting on the next business day after successful payment. Business days are Monday through Friday, excluding public holidays observed by the production facility and carrier. Orders placed on weekends or holidays begin processing on the next business day. Express shipping changes transit speed, not production time.

Shipping charges in US dollars
Standard: {{standard_first}} for the first item plus {{standard_additional}} for each additional item in the same order.
Express: {{express_first}} for the first item plus {{express_additional}} for each additional item in the same order.
Shipping is based on the total number of items in your order. Items may arrive in separate packages without an additional split-shipment fee. Your item total, selected shipping charge and applicable taxes are shown before payment.

Estimated transit after shipment
Standard: {{standard_transit}}.
Express: {{express_transit}}.
Your total delivery estimate includes both processing and transit. Arrival dates are estimates and are not guaranteed. Carrier disruptions, public holidays and peak demand may affect timing.

Tracking and delays
Need a shipment update or help with tracking? Email {{support_email}} with your order reference. Tracking may take time to show movement after the carrier receives a parcel. If we cannot ship within the stated processing period, we will notify you with a revised estimate and the option to cancel for a full refund. We will obtain your consent to a delay where required by law.

Missing, damaged or misdelivered orders
Email {{support_email}} if your order has not arrived by the latest estimated delivery date. We will review the delivery details and investigate with our fulfillment partner or carrier. If an order is confirmed lost in transit, you may choose a free replacement or a refund of the affected items, shipping and applicable tax. A delivery scan alone does not prevent you from reporting a missing parcel. For damage or an incorrect item, follow the 30-day reporting procedure in our Returns & Refunds policy.

Address corrections
Check your delivery address before paying. Contact us immediately if it needs a correction; we can change it before production starts, but changes after that point are not guaranteed. If a parcel is returned as undeliverable because of an address you entered incorrectly, we will explain the available options and any reshipping charge before you agree to it. We cover the cost when the addressing error was ours. This does not limit your statutory rights.

Frequently Asked Questions
pages.content:
What does TeeBravo sell?
We sell printed clothing and accessories with designs based on hobbies, everyday interests and holidays. Each item is printed after you order. The product page shows the styles and options available for that design.

Where do you ship?
{{restrictions}}

How much does shipping cost?
Standard costs {{standard_first}} for the first item, plus {{standard_additional}} for each additional item in the same order. Express costs {{express_first}} for the first item, plus {{express_additional}} for each additional item. All charges are in US dollars, and you can review shipping and applicable taxes before paying.

When should I expect my order?
Allow {{processing_time}} for processing, followed by {{standard_transit}} in transit for Standard or {{express_transit}} for Express. Add the two periods together for the total estimate. Express speeds up transit; it does not shorten production. These are estimates, not guaranteed arrival dates. See our Shipping Policy for details and help with delays.

How do I choose a size?
Compare the measurements in the size guide with a garment you own. Use the guide for the style you plan to order, since fit and measurements can differ between products.

Can I return or exchange my order?
{{returns_eligibility}}

How do I report a damaged or incorrect item?
{{returns_window}}
Email {{support_email}} with your order reference, checkout email and a description of the issue. Include photos where possible. Approved claims do not require a physical return. Read Returns & Refunds for the full request process and refund timing.

Can I change or cancel an order?
Email {{support_email}} as soon as possible. We can change your order or cancel it with a full refund before production starts. Once production begins, we cannot accept change-of-mind cancellations or guarantee changes. Your rights for faulty goods and shipping delays still apply. See our Terms of Service for details.

What payment methods can I use?
We accept card payments through Stripe checkout. The payment options available for your order are shown at checkout. Prices and payments are in US dollars.

How can I check on my delivery?
Email {{support_email}} with your order reference for shipment or tracking help. If the latest estimated delivery date has passed, let us know so we can investigate.

How do I contact TeeBravo?
Use the form at {{storefront_url}}/contact or email {{support_email}}. Include your order reference if you have one. Do not send passwords or payment card details.
